'''Move''' is an integral and important [[Stats|stat]] in the ''Tactics'' series of [[Final Fantasy series|''Final Fantasy'']] games. It is the stat that determines how far a unit can travel from their current position, and works in tangent with the [[Jump (stat)|Jump]] statistic, in scenarios in which the player can or cannot cross over tiles lower or higher than the spot they are at. All job classes have a set Move counter, which can further be increased either by abilities or pieces of equipment.

== Appearances ==
=== ''[[Final Fantasy Tactics]]'' ===
{{Quote|A combination of the unit's base movement range and any job, equipment, or ability bonuses. The higher the number, the farther the unit can move.|Description (PSP)}}
"Move" or "Movement" is the stat that determines how far a unit can move on their turn. The base movement is determined by the unit's [[Final Fantasy Tactics jobs|job]], and can be increased further via equipment like [[Battle Boots (Tactics)|battle boots]] and [[Germinas Boots (Tactics)|Germinas boots]], and via the [[Final Fantasy Tactics movement abilities|movement abilities]] [[Movement +1 (Tactics)|Movement +1]], [[Movement +2 (Tactics)|+2]], and [[Movement +3 (Tactics)|+3]]. Terrain may give movement penalties, such as when wading through water without [[Swim (Tactics)|Swim]].

The range of [[Throw (Tactics)|Throw]] is equal to the unit's movement stat.
